title: Thunderbird eventually stops polling
creator: NZsnowMan
content:
When my machine reboots (far more often than I'd prefer, tbh), Thunderbird starts automatically, and works fine. Messages sent and received. Eventually, some accounts just stop receiving.. afaik, I'm sending fine (although, I might never know), but I realize after a while that some accounts have not received for a few days. I run "Get Messages" on specific accounts - like waiting for a 2FA code, and usually they come in. But then I restart T-bird, and a flood of mails from (sometimes) 5 days ago arrive; missed invoice requests, Tax Dept, reminders, Customer replies, and (even more important, Dominos deal vouchers !)... very inconvenient.

'Anyone else experiencing this ?'

Network is fine, PC is online (trust me, I'd notice) Some emails arrive, usually in other accounts.

Tbird version: 140.14.1esr (64-bit) - but I think it's just doing an update now (esr channel) Accounts with issues are POP, my own domain, so I control everything.

Can't tell how often or after how long this occurs, as usually I am swamped with work once they come back online.. so I don't make records.

I will though.
